slides.texte_overlay:
Things that make you
surprisingly good at
talking to women
Treat her like a person, not a target. Talk to her the way you'd talk to an interesting new friend. Pressure disappears and the conversation becomes natural.
Be genuinely interested in her world. Her job, her city, her weird hobby. Ask because you want to know, not because you're trying to impress.
Don't fake agreement. If you like a different film or a different city, say so with a smile. A little friendly disagreement makes conversations fun.
Notice when she's not interested, and respect it. A short answer, a turned shoulder. Reading the signs and leaving politely is a skill too.
Bring something new to talk about. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a good story makes any conversation easier.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A good story makes any conversation easier.

slides.texte_overlay: Be relaxed about the outcome. You're just two people talking. When you stop needing it to go somewhere, you become much better company.
End on a warm note. "It was really nice talking to you." Leaving with kindness matters, whatever happens next. Kindness is always attractive.
